title: AI Foundations for Beginners
description: A plain-language introduction to what AI is, what it can do well, and where it falls short.
audience: Anyone curious about AI, with no technical background required.
objectives: Understand core AI concepts in everyday terms
Use AI assistants confidently for daily tasks

title: Prompt Engineering Essentials
description: Learn to give clear instructions to AI tools and get more reliable results.
audience: Professionals and learners who already use AI tools and want better results.

title: Vibe Coding Without Traditional Programming
description: Build working software by describing what you want and guiding AI coding tools.
audience: Non-programmers who want to create software.
objectives: Describe an app idea so AI can build it

title: Building Websites with AI
description: Plan, create and publish a simple website using AI-assisted tools.
audience: Small business owners, creators and career changers.
objectives: Generate and refine a site with AI

title: Creating AI Agents and Chatbots
description: Explore how AI agents work and design a simple assistant for a specific purpose.
audience: Learners and business owners interested in custom assistants.
objectives: Understand how agents use instructions and tools
Test behavior and set sensible boundaries

title: Business Automation with AI
description: Find repetitive tasks in a small business and automate them with AI-assisted workflows.
audience: Small business owners and operations professionals.
objectives: Measure results and keep humans in the loop

title: Developing Your First MVP
description: Turn an idea into a minimum viable product you can put in front of real users.
objectives: Build a first prototype with AI tools
Plan how to gather user feedback

title: Launching and Managing a Digital Product
description: Understand the practical steps of releasing, supporting and improving a digital product.
audience: Builders preparing to release their first product.

title: AI Safety, Security, and Responsible Development
description: Practical habits for privacy, security and human oversight when building with AI.
audience: Anyone building or deploying AI-assisted tools.

title: From Technology Learner to Entrepreneur
description: Bring skills together to shape a product idea into a sustainable venture plan.
